SELECT a.* FROM (SELECT D_ACCT, S_TRECODE, s_tredscr, PROCODE, PRONAME, FORMAT(F_AMT / #{params.amtUnit}, 2) AS F_AMT, FORMAT(((F_AMT - F_AMT_tb) / F_AMT_tb) * 100, 2) AS F_AMT_tb, FORMAT(F_AMT_year / #{params.amtUnit}, 2) AS F_AMT_year, FORMAT( ( (F_AMT_year - F_AMT_year_tb) / F_AMT_year_tb ) * 100, 2 ) AS F_AMT_year_tb, industry, CONCAT(@rank := @rank + 1, '') AS rank FROM (SELECT a.D_ACCT, a.S_TRECODE, a.s_tredscr, a.PROCODE, a.PRONAME, a.F_AMT AS F_AMT, a.F_AMT_year AS F_AMT_year, b.F_AMT_tb AS F_AMT_tb, b.F_AMT_year_tb AS F_AMT_year_tb, a.industry FROM (SELECT D_ACCT, S_TRECODE, s_tredscr, PROCODE, PRONAME, SUM(F_AMT) AS F_AMT , SUM(F_AMT_year) AS F_AMT_year, IF( #{params.industryType} = TRUE, #{params.industryName}, LEV_4_DSCR ) AS industry FROM ${params.tableName} where 1=1
AND D_ACCT = #{params.D_ACCT}
AND S_TRECODE IN(${params.S_TRECODE})
AND (LEV_1_ID IN(${params.industryId}) or LEV_2_ID IN(${params.industryId}))
GROUP BY PRONAME ORDER BY SUM(F_AMT_year) DESC LIMIT 100) a LEFT JOIN (SELECT S_TRECODE, s_tredscr, PROCODE, PRONAME, SUM(F_AMT) AS F_AMT_tb, SUM(F_AMT_year) AS F_AMT_year_tb, IF( #{params.industryType} = TRUE, #{params.industryName}, LEV_4_DSCR ) AS industry FROM ${params.tableName} WHERE 1 = 1
AND D_ACCT = date_format(date_sub(concat(#{params.D_ACCT},'-01'),interval 1 year),'%Y-%m')
AND S_TRECODE IN(${params.S_TRECODE})
AND (LEV_1_ID IN(${params.industryId}) or LEV_2_ID IN(${params.industryId}))
GROUP BY PRONAME) b ON a.s_trecode = b.s_trecode AND a.PRONAME = b.PRONAME AND a.industry = b.industry ) a, (SELECT @rank := 0) b ORDER BY a.F_AMT_year DESC LIMIT 0, 50) a ORDER BY CONVERT(rank, DECIMAL)
LIMIT ${params.page},${params.rows}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT * FROM ${params.tableName} a where 1=1
AND D_ACCT = #{params.D_ACCT}
AND S_TRECODE IN(${params.S_TRECODE})
AND (LEV_1_ID IN(${params.industryId}) or LEV_2_ID IN(${params.industryId}))
GROUP BY PRONAME LIMIT 0,50 ) ss

select * from ( select LEV_1_ID as id,LEV_1_DSCR as name, '' as pId from edw.cm_clr_industry_info c GROUP BY c.LEV_2_ID union select LEV_2_ID as id,LEV_2_DSCR as name,SUBSTRING(LEV_2_ID, 1, 1 ) as pId from edw.cm_clr_industry_info c where c.LEV_1_ID not in ('GR','WS') GROUP BY c.LEV_2_ID ) a
